messages:
sam_cs: Customer reported weird trailing backticks and a stray '---' line after code blocks in responses from redwood-large-v2. Started after yesterday's canary. Pasted customer's excerpt below:
> ...response snippet...
> ```
> print(\'hello\')
> ```
> ---

ingrid_eng: Can you paste the full request payload (model, prompt, any stop tokens) + request_id? Also was streaming enabled?

sam_cs: model=redwood-large-v2, prompt contains an example fenced block, no explicit stop_tokens set by customer. req_id=rcp_20260316_9876. They were using streaming True.

alyssa_oncall: deploy-bot shows a canary rollout at 2026-03-16T22:58:00 for redwood-serving:3.14. There was a small tokenizer/normalization change included.

ingrid_eng: I tried a quick repro locally with streaming on and the same prompt, I can reproduce the trailing '---' line after the closing fence. Looks like our newline normalization in 3.14 can insert a short separator token at chunk boundaries which the fence-guard heuristic then misclassifies.

mike_prod: Did we change default stop/termination behavior in runtime config?

ingrid_eng: We enabled newline collapsing by default in 3.14 (normalize_newlines=true). That interacts poorly with the fence termination guard when responses are chunked.

ingrid_eng: Short-term mitigation: ask customers to pass explicit stop tokens (e.g. stop_tokens=["```"]) or disable streaming. Longer term: revert the normalization in canary/rollout and add a sanitizer that removes lone fence terminators followed by short delimiter lines.

sam_cs: Customer is on paid plan and asking for an immediate rollback. They're worried about broken snippets in docs pages.

alyssa_oncall: Initiating rollback to redwood-serving:3.13 now. @deploy-bot please start.

deploy-bot: "Started rollback of redwood-serving to 3.13 (triggered by @alyssa_oncall)"

ingrid_eng: I'm opening a PR (#4218) for a boundary-safe fence detector + sanitizer; will add unit tests and an integration test for streaming chunk edges. ETA for patch: ~2h.

mike_prod: Customer workaround communicated. Also note we should include this as a regression item in the incident tracker and update public status if it affects more customers.

sam_cs: Customer confirmed after rollback that the trailing '---' and extra backticks disappeared when they retried streaming. They said it's fixed for them.

ingrid_eng: Root cause summary: tokenizer newline normalization change in 3.14 combined with streaming chunk boundaries caused the fence-termination guard to miss matches; produced stray delimiter artifacts at the end of streamed chunks. Fix: revert normalization and add sanitizer + improved fence detection logic.

mike_prod: Add to release notes: "Fix: Markdown code-fence termination regression (3.14) causing stray delimiter artifacts in streamed outputs."

deploy-bot: "Rollback completed at 2026-03-16T23:20:00"

sam_cs: Closing this thread, customer confirmed resolution. Thanks everyone :pray:
